data.name: AETHER RUSH
data.detailed_description:
Discover ÆTHER RUSH – The first game in the AFTERLIFE franchise

ÆTHER RUSH is a semi-open exploration-adventure game with delivery mechanics, set in the AFTERLIFE universe. You play as an independent courier in Lumina, a vertical cyberpunk city where ASTRAEN and DOVAREN clash for control of Æther. As a direct prequel to AFTERLIFE, this game is a key technical and narrative pillar of the universe.

As a mercenary courier, you must navigate the suspended heights of Lumina—floating platforms, aerial docks, and crowded corridors. Every Æther delivery is a challenge: prepare your vehicle, optimize routes, dodge surveillance drones, and manage an unstable resource. Your alliances shape your reputation and opportunities: work for ASTRAEN, side with the DOVAREN, or remain neutral to thrive in the chaos.

  • Plan routes and customize modules to complete missions.

  • Gain reputation and rewards with ASTRAEN or DOVAREN.

  • Explore platforms, aerial corridors, and corrupted zones of Lumina.

  • Upgrade engines, armor, and tools to deliver faster and farther.

data.short_description: Become a mercenary courier in Lumina. Every Æther delivery is risky and coveted. Upgrade your vehicle, evade patrols, and choose your alliances: ASTRAEN or DOVAREN. Earn reputation, exclusive perks… and enemies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
